devices: design: the main synth: a wavetable pluck for the attack + a soft saw lead with a late vibrato
design: the supersaw bright (low-pass 6.5 kHz), a 1-semitone rise into each stab, a 1/16 square tremolo

Snare + clap: the build's roll (quarters → 32nds, rising, climbing an octave), the breath, one big clap; in the drop a snare a semitone up and a clap together on 3, one room

Reese bass: the verse's reese under the build's first six bars, then gone
Sub: a sine sub, mono, on the chord's root WITH every drop kick (the kick's rhythm is the bassline's), ducked 14 dB by the kick and back within ~200 ms
Mid bass: the bass's voice an octave up: saws and a square, low-passed 1.4 kHz, tube-driven, high-passed at 160 Hz so the sub owns the low end; ducked 14 dB by the kick

elements.recipe: the Drum Machine's snare tuned up 3 st, 170 ms, bright, with a clap on it, a sharper attack, a short room — on beat 3

elements.name: Saw
elements.recipe: wider (detune 0.5, blend 0.85), the octave stack louder (0.6), more noise: bright and big. Straight: it speaks in 1 ms, holds flat, stops in 30 ms at the snare; no pitch move. Low cut 150 Hz, nearly dry, ducked 12 dB by the kick

elements.name: Bass
elements.recipe: the 808: a sine with a 5-semitone thump in its first 18 ms, driven (0.55) so it is heard on small speakers, no glide between notes. HEAVIER: the 808 driven harder (0.8), and an octave over it a saw and a square through a ladder at 340 Hz driven 16 dB, then a tube — and 2 dB louder in the mix With every kick, the saw's lengths, no glide; mono; ducked 14 dB by the kick and back in ~150 ms

elements.name: Lead
elements.recipe: the melody — Three notes: a long note, a step down, a long note — the same rhythm every two bars (a simple line, so the saw is what you judge). THE SOUND — Glass stack: a 7-voice saw with a 3-voice pulse beside it and a breath of noise, and a 5-voice pulse an octave up, quiet; a 24 dB ladder low at 2.4 kHz that an envelope opens 2 octaves at every note and lets fall in 0.4 s, fluttered by an LFO at a 32nd note; it slides 140 ms; low cut 180 Hz, an echo, a 2.4 s room; 84 % of its strong notes are in the chord under them
